propositions: Acceptance criteria with operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, store-surgery) that lack `[operator-attested]` tags should be surfaced at plan time via a deterministic advisory lint, not discovered at verification time.
A new deterministic lexicon-based lint must extend `p6_ac_quality` without adding a `P10` check, modifying `DET_CHECKS` cardinality, or touching `criteria_routing.json`.

The `[operator-attested]` tag matcher must be single-sourced in `det_operator_attested._OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE` and imported by `workflow_ops`, so the plan-time lint and the completion-verifier agreement on tagging is enforced by construction.

The lint's self-gate eval (locked lexicon over frozen AC corpus of 3091 items) must achieve precision ≥ 70% on a ≥ 50-item sample, flag rate ≤ 5%, and be committed before the lint activation in a verifiable git-ancestry order.
Known historical cases (tickets 115b and 8c4f) must fire on their tag-stripped AC text as unit-test fixtures, and already-tagged items must not be flagged.
The lint ships advisory and prompt-less in the packaged registry, never blocking `p6_ac_quality` (status fail, blocking False), with docs and full test coverage.
